headline: 久保兼 vaults from 1,158th to 78th on ARC-3

sections.text: 久保兼 gained 5.71 points to reach 33.98, moving from 1,158th to 78th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The climb puts the team inside the top 100 after starting the day in the four-digit ranks. Public standings remain provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
